## Change History

_Detailed change log for this best practice. Include all significant modifications, updates, and revisions._

| Date       | Version | Author        | Description                    | Impact                  |
| ---------- | ------- | ------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------- |
| YYYY-MM-DD | 1.0.0   | [Author Name] | Initial best practice creation | New practice            |
| YYYY-MM-DD | 1.1.0   | [Author Name] | [Description of changes]       | [Implementation impact] |

**Change Entry Guidelines:**

- **Date**: Use YYYY-MM-DD format
- **Version**: Follow semantic versioning (major.minor.patch)
- **Author**: Full name or identifier of person making change
- **Description**: Detailed explanation of what changed and why
- **Impact**: Specify implementation impact and any migration requirements

## Template Usage Instructions

1. **Copy this template** to create a new best practice document
2. **Replace all bracketed placeholders** with actual content
3. **Remove template instructions** before publishing
4. **Follow the directory and naming convention**:
    - Directory: `strategy/best-practices/[category]/[practice-type]/`
    - Filename: `[category]-[practice-type]-best-practice.md`
    - Best Practice ID: `BP-[CATEGORY]-[TYPE]-[NNN]`
    - Example: `strategy/best-practices/engineering/devops/engineering-devops-best-practice.md`
5. **Generate a unique best practice ID** following the convention: `BP-{CATEGORY}-{TYPE}-{NNN}`
6. **Complete all required sections** before submitting for review
7. **Include evidence of successful implementation** and quantifiable results
8. **Validate against quality checklist** before submission

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] All metadata fields completed
- [ ] Executive summary clearly states purpose and business value
- [ ] Evidence of successful implementation documented
- [ ] Context and background thoroughly documented
- [ ] Core practice description is comprehensive and actionable
- [ ] Implementation methodology is practical and complete
- [ ] Practical application section provides concrete steps
- [ ] Measurement and validation approaches are defined
- [ ] Examples and case studies demonstrate real-world success
- [ ] Integration with enterprise architecture is documented
- [ ] Governance and quality considerations are addressed
- [ ] Related practices and references are accurate and relevant
- [ ] Change history section is complete with initial entry
- [ ] Review log section is present and properly formatted
- [ ] Document follows markdown formatting standards
- [ ] Content demonstrates proven effectiveness through quantifiable results
- [ ] Best practice has been reviewed by relevant experts and stakeholders
